route_matrix.key_bound: The first positive raw-hotset 10 tok/s bound requires top4096 at 17 GiB with about 1.009 s zero-overhead slack, while the only fitting extra pool is about 3.188 GiB. Native MXFP4 payload is already information-dense; measured and entropy-implied exact lossless reduction is about 1.04x, far below the required 5.33x. Therefore no current exact compact representation path can make top4096 fit without a fundamentally new model representation or a correctness-verified non-exact verifier.
